# FreelanceDesk

> FreelanceDesk is a private, offline Android app for freelancers to create invoices and quotations, manage clients and orders, record payments and see their income. The website also has a free invoice generator and a free quotation generator.

Publisher: LYGENEX Labs. Contact: media@lygenexlabs.com

## Key pages
- [Free invoice generator](https://freelancedesk.lygenexlabs.com/free-invoice-generator/): make a PDF invoice in the browser, 2 free per month
- [Free quotation generator](https://freelancedesk.lygenexlabs.com/free-quotation-generator/): make a PDF quotation in the browser, 2 free per month
- [Blog](https://freelancedesk.lygenexlabs.com/blog/): guides on invoicing, pricing, getting paid and starting as a freelancer
- [Help center](https://freelancedesk.lygenexlabs.com/help/): how to use the app
- [What's new](https://freelancedesk.lygenexlabs.com/whats-new/): release notes
- [Contact](https://freelancedesk.lygenexlabs.com/contact/)

## Facts
- App: Android, on Google Play. iPhone version: waitlist at /app-store/
- Price: free to download (up to 5 orders, 2 templates). Premium is $1.99 a month or $14.99 a year, billed by Google Play, with a free trial
- 20 invoice templates and 6 quotation templates in the app
- Data stays on the phone: no account, no ads, no tracking in the app
